structure.unit: Virginia Disposition Of Unclaimed Property Act
Definitions; Property Abandoned or Assumed Abandoned

law.catch_line: Holder of tangible or intangible personal property may voluntarily report such property
law.text: Any holder of tangible or intangible personal property the owner of which is unlocatable may voluntarily report the property to the administrator, prior to the statutory due dates, whereupon the property shall be presumed abandoned under this chapter.
